lifetime.name: lifetime
lifetime.description: encapsulation_lifetime_h vs NI TOS band 4–50 h

ermakova_takenaka_joint_summary.definition: A joint hit is one scorable row (usable baseline: complete, not mock, not X>X_eq, carbon balance when reported) with filament_yield in [8.0, 10.0] gC/(gNi·h) AND encapsulation_lifetime_h in [4.0, 50.0]. Same cell, reactor, T, and (A_γ, θ*, s0).
ermakova_takenaka_joint_summary.read: In-band yield is a high-Cδ / low-A_γ row (surface already encapsulating). In-band lifetime is a high-A_γ / low-T / low-s0 row where Cδ is a trickle. The arrival rate that fills the Ermakova band also fills θ* inside the pass; the transport that keeps θ_encap a trickle over-produces filaments. No extra DOF was added to force an overlap.
